reviews.text: Friendly and with very good recommendations.
They treated our dog in an emergency, and Lucia was very friendly and helpful, thank you!

I've taken my dog ​​there several times and I'm always very happy with the care. He's a highly experienced veterinarian, especially in cardiology, and it really shows when he examines animals: he can detect and listen to any heart murmur with great precision, which inspires a lot of confidence.

In addition to his professionalism, his service is excellent. He always treats you with great kindness, takes his time to explain everything, and usually has a pleasant conversation while attending to your pet, making the visit very comfortable and relaxed.

The clinic has consultation rooms for both cats and dogs and offers many services to care for our pets. Without a doubt, it's a highly recommended place for anyone looking for a trustworthy veterinarian.
Very friendly and professional service. Highly recommended clinic.
Today I went with my greyhounds for the first time, they were very kind and professional, I'm very happy

We visited the vet today with our dog Yordy. We called first and they had time for us immediately; excellent treatment. Friendly, very professional, and dog-friendly. We received pain medication and a good explanation. They speak good English and took plenty of time (1 hour). We are very satisfied and can fully recommend them.

They have always been very professional in treating my pet and advising me about her health. Unfortunately, very recently I had to request euthanasia for my beloved cat (who was in the terminal stage), and they came to my house at my request without any hesitation. They made everything easy during such a difficult time. I will always be grateful to them for that.
Hi Tania, thank you so much for your feedback. Greetings from the team at Vinaroz Veterinary Clinic.
